item.title: The giant Warwolf monster hurler
item.description: Discover the power of the Warwolf, history’s most formidable trebuchet, in this interactive simulator. Test your siege engineering skills by calculating the flight distance and squish penalty of iconic roleplaying game monsters.

item.title: MP3 co-inventor launches Okeanos Pro AR audio system
item.description: The Okeanos Pro from Brandenburg Labs uses AR to simulate 16 virtual loudspeakers for professional audio mixing and immersive environments.

item.title: Viva La Dirt League and Critical Role team up for Daggerheart: Azerim
item.description: Viva La Dirt League partners with Critical Role for Daggerheart: Azerim. The new actual play series features Baradun and the Dickheads facing a Void horror.

item.title: Check out the ‘Lone Wolf and Cub’ (and other manga classics) bundle from Humble
item.description: Dark Horse Comics have rereleased their popular Lone Wolf and Cub (and other manga classics) bundle for a limited time only

item.title: Games Workshop isn’t just banning AI; it’s positioning “Human Made” as the ultimate luxury product
item.description: By rejecting AI and hiring more artists, Games Workshop is differentiating itself from competitors like Wizards of the Coast and securing a "talent moat" for the future.

item.title: First look at Sophie Turner as Lara Croft in Prime’s upcoming Tomb Raider series
item.description: Production kicked off this month for Prime's live-action Tomb Raider series, and now we have our first look at Sophie Turner in the role she's been preparing for since LAST FEBRUARY. Damn, girl.

item.title: Paradox opens White-Wolf.store for official Vampire: The Masquerade apparel
item.description: Paradox Interactive has launched White-Wolf store, a new official outlet for World of Darkness apparel. Meanwhile, By Night Studios runs a Valentine's sale.

item.title: Gaming for Good: Asmodee UK and Mind team up to tackle loneliness
item.description: Asmodee UK and Mind have announced a three-year partnership to combat loneliness through board games. The initiative launches at Toy Fair 2026.

item.title: The latest trailer for ‘The Bride!’ filled with anarchic attitude, gun-toting undead and fantasy monster romance
item.description: We’ve now got the first full trailer for Maggie Gyllenhaal‘s The Bride! to share with you – and what a trailer it is, with anarchic attitude galore, along with gun-toting undead and a bit of fantasy/tragedy monster romance. item.title: The Human Touch: The growing list of tabletop companies banning AI
item.description: Discover which tabletop gaming companies have banned generative AI. From Games Workshop to Paizo, we list the publishers committed to human-made roleplaying games.
